tasks.title: Update archiveChange() with date prefix and conflict handling
tasks.description: Modify ChangeArtifactsManager.archiveChange() to use YYYY-MM-DD-<name> archive directory format with conflict handling (-v2, -v3 suffixes). Ensure no spec sync occurs during archive. Also update restoreChange() to find date-prefixed archive entries and strip the date prefix on restore.
acceptanceCriteria: archiveChange() moves directory to openspec/changes/archive/YYYY-MM-DD-<name>/
Date prefix uses current date in local timezone
Existing archive with same name triggers -v2, -v3 suffix incrementing
No files under openspec/specs/ are modified during archive
session-memories are preserved in the archived directory
restoreChange() finds archived entries with date prefix (e.g. 2026-05-01-42-fix-auth)
restoreChange() strips date prefix when restoring (restores to changes/42-fix-auth not changes/2026-05-01-42-fix-auth)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Current archiveChange() at line 284 uses plain <name> without date prefix. Reference archive-change.ts conflict handling pattern but target openspec/changes/archive/ not openspec/archive/. CRITICAL: restoreChange() at line 308 uses startsWith('${issueNumber}-') which won't match date-prefixed archives like '2026-05-01-42-fix-auth'. Must update search to handle date prefix AND strip prefix on restore.

tasks.title: Add archiveChange to StageContext interface and wire into CheckStageRunner
tasks.description: Add archiveChange(issueNumber: number): Promise<void> to the ChangeArtifactsManager interface in stage-context.ts. Then modify CheckStageRunner.run() to call ctx.artifactManager.archiveChange() after all checks pass and before returning requiresApproval:true. Catch archive errors gracefully (log but don't block).
acceptanceCriteria: stage-context.ts ChangeArtifactsManager interface includes archiveChange method
CheckStageRunner calls archiveChange after all checks pass, before returning approval gate
Archive failure is caught and logged, does not block check stage
Archive file changes do not trigger re-evaluation of checks
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Design D1: archive in CheckStageRunner between allPassed and requiresApproval. Design D3: extend stage-context.ts interface. Risk mitigation: catch archive errors gracefully per design doc.

tasks.title: Remove openspec archiving from IssueService.performCleanup()

performCleanup() still cleans worktree and checkpoints
Issue archive does not attempt to move openspec change directory
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Remove lines 280-287 in issue-service.ts performCleanup(). The ChangeArtifactsManager import can stay if unarchive still uses it (line 226).
